title: Each other
goal: Say what people do to each other or together, with -(Y)ş and biri-biri.

intro.text: The reciprocal `-(Y)ş` is for what people do to each other or with each other: *görmek* → *görüşmek* (to meet), *düşünmek* → *düşünişmek* (to understand each other). Where you need **each other** with a case, use *biri-biri*: *biri-birine kömek etmek*, to help each other.

vocab.en: to agree, to come to an agreement
to keep in touch, to contact each other

exercises.question: How do you say **we met** (we saw each other)?

why.1: *Gördük* is **we saw**, one way. Meeting each other takes the reciprocal *-üş*.
why.2: After a consonant the reciprocal has its vowel: *gör-* + *-üş*.
why.3: From the third syllable on, the vowel is *i*: *görüşdik*.

exercises.explain: *gör-* + *-üş* (reciprocal, rounded after *ö*) + *-di* + *-k*. The third syllable has *i*.
*Kömek etmek* takes the dative, so *biri-birine*, to each other.

reject.why: *Düşünýäris* is just **we understand**. For **each other**, use the reciprocal: *düşünişýäris*.

accept: I talked to Aýna on the phone.
I talked with Aýna on the phone
I had a chat with Aýna on the phone

exercises.label: *görüşmek* (to meet), past: I met (someone), you met…
exercises.explain: *görüş-* + the past *-di* and its endings. From the third syllable on the vowel is *i*.

exercises.question: Which sentence means **They know each other**?

why.2: *Biri-biri* takes the case of the verb; *tanamak* needs the accusative.

exercises.explain: *tanamak* (to know a person) takes the accusative, so *biri-birini*.

exercises.prompt: She introduced me to her mother.
exercises.explain: *tanyş-* (get to know each other) + *-dyr* (make): introduce. The other person goes with *bilen*.

accept: We keep in touch every week.
We are in touch every week
We get in touch every week
We contact each other every week
We [talk|speak] to each other every week

pairs: to get to know each other

exercises.explain: For **we**, *biri-biri* takes our possessive and the dative of *kömek etmek*: *biri-birimize*.

exercises.question: *Olaryň gatnaşygy örän gowy.* What does it mean?

why.1: Meeting often would be *Olar köplenç görüşýärler*.
why.2: Living close would be *Olar ýakyn ýaşaýarlar*.

exercises.explain: *gatnaşyk* is a relationship: theirs is very good.
